plan: A fighter who grows stronger and stronger over the game by last-hitting minions with his Q.
aSurveiller: His Q (Siphoning Strike). Every minion finished with it gives permanent bonus damage: the longer the game, the harder he hits.
contrer: Poke him early to stop him finishing minions with his Q.
Try to end the game quickly: he becomes very strong in the late game.
Watch out for his W: it heavily slows you and stops you from escaping.
forces: His W slows a huge amount.
faiblesses: Very weak in the early game.

sorts.Q: Strike that gains permanent damage if it kills the target.
sorts.W: Heavily slows an enemy and reduces their attack speed.
sorts.E: Zone that damages and reduces armour.
sorts.R: Becomes giant: more health, resistances and damage.

momentFort: Weak early. He becomes dangerous around level 9 and with his Q stacks, then dominates the mid game.
